fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) has risen approximately 2.4% since its last earnings announcement, outperforming the S&P 500.
fields.summary_ko.1: Third-quarter adjusted EPS of $5.75 missed consensus of $5.94, but net income of 1.53 billion dollars increased 6% year-over-year and net interest income (NII) grew 13% to 27.04 billion dollars.
